corePassives.description:
After Yoruichi successfully dodges an enemy attack, tap the basic attack button to release the dodge attack Hakuda - Stomping Strike and gain 20% Spiritual Pressure. This counts as a special attack. 
 After releasing Hakuda Stomping Strike, tap the basic attack button again to instantly perform the 5th strike of her basic attack.
corePassives.name: Lightning Flash

corePassives.description:
Yoruichi gains 1 stack of Lightning Seal for 15 seconds each time she releases a technique, counterattack, or special attack. Stacks up to 4 times. 
 Lightning Seal: Increases Yoruichi's Strike DMG by 10%.
corePassives.name: Thunderclap

corePassives.description: By dodging into an enemy, Yoruichi can trigger Perfect Dodge and increase the damage of her next special attack, Hakuda Blitz, by 200%.
corePassives.name: Shadow Step

corePassives.description: While in the Shunko form, Yoruichi gains an extra 30% increase in ATK.
corePassives.name: Swift Lightning

skills.description:
Yoruichi strikes the enemy 5 times with martial arts, dealing damage equal to 716% of ATK and gaining Spiritual Pressure. ~~Hakuda - Blitz~~ Press and hold basic attack at max Spiritual Pressure 
 Yoruichi leaps high into the air and charges briefly to smash the target, dealing damage equal to 270% of ATK. ~~Hakuda - Stomping Strike~~ Tap basic attack after dodging an enemy attack 
 Yoruichi quickly leaps above the target and stomps down, dealing damage equal to 136% of ATK.
skills.name: Hakuda - Combo

skills.description:
Yoruichi approaches the target with Flash Step, stomps on them, and attacks with a shuriken, dealing damage equal to 348% of ATK. 
 After releasing this skill, immediately tap basic attack to follow up with the special attack, Hakuda - Stomping Strike.
skills.name: Anken, Dark Sword

skills.description: Yoruichi wraps herself in highly compressed Kido and enters Shunko, instantly launching a powerful strike on the target, which deals DMG equal to 988% of ATK. Shunko lasts for 10s, during which Yoruichi's ATK increases by 20% and her Spiritual Pressure Charge Rate increases by 60%. She can also instantly release a special attack without consuming Spiritual Pressure.
skills.name: Shunko

skills.description: Yoruichi rapidly approaches the enemy and launches countless attacks instantly, dealing damage equal to 1500.25% of ATK.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description: Use Flash Step to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Yoruichi gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15s. Perfect Dodges also restore 20% of Yoruichi's Spiritual Pressure.
skills.name: Flash Step
